items.q: How quickly will I receive my order?
items.a: As soon as your payment is confirmed, your order details and any keys or download links are sent to the email you provided — usually within minutes.

items.q: What do I receive after I place an order?
items.a: You receive everything you need to use your product, including activation keys where applicable and download or access instructions, delivered to your email inbox.
Yes. Bigbl is operated by Keyversely LLC, and products are sourced through authorized channels and verified before they go on sale.

Because digital products are delivered instantly and can be used right away, purchases are non-refundable once the key or access link has been sent. If you have a genuine issue, contact our support team and we will do our best to help.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept all major credit and debit cards via Stripe, as well as PayPal.

items.q: What if I don't receive the email with my order?
items.a: First check your spam or junk folder. If it is not there, contact us at support@keyversely.com and we will resend your order details within minutes.

items.q: Do your products work in my country?
items.a: Most of our digital products are available worldwide. Check the product page for any regional notes before ordering.
Every purchase includes support. If you need help accessing or activating your product, contact us and our team will assist you.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By accessing or using the Bigbl website (the 'Website'), you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the Website.

sections.heading: 2. Products and Services
sections.body: Bigbl, operated by Keyversely LLC, sells digital products including software keys, game keys, subscriptions and gift cards. All products are delivered electronically.

sections.heading: 3. Digital Delivery
sections.body: Immediately after a successful payment, product details, keys and access instructions are sent to the email address you provided. You are responsible for providing a valid and accessible email address.

sections.heading: 4. Refund Policy
sections.body: Due to the instant electronic delivery of digital products, all sales are final and non-refundable once the product has been delivered. Exceptions are considered on a case-by-case basis for genuine delivery or technical issues.

sections.heading: 5. License Usage
sections.body: You may use the purchased products only for your own personal or business use in accordance with the applicable licensing terms. Reselling, sharing, or redistributing keys is prohibited.

sections.heading: 6. Intellectual Property
sections.body: All content on the Website, including text, graphics, logos, and software, is the property of KeyVersely LLC or its licensors and is protected by applicable intellectual property laws.

sections.heading: 7. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, KeyVersely LLC shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of the Website or our products.

sections.heading: 8. Governing Law
sections.body: These Terms and Conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Wyoming, United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.

sections.heading: 9. Contact Information
sections.body: If you have any questions about these Terms, contact us at support@keyversely.com or write to KeyVersely LLC, 63 N Burritt Ave Rm 100 Pmb 1180, Buffalo, Wyoming 82834 USA.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
sections.body: KeyVersely LLC ('we', 'us', or 'our') operates the Bigbl website. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name and email address when you place an order, create an account, or contact support. We also automatically collect technical information such as your IP address, browser type, and pages visited.

sections.heading: 3. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your information to process and deliver your orders, communicate with you, improve our Website, prevent fraud, and comply with legal obligations.

sections.heading: 4. Cookies and Tracking
sections.body: We use cookies to improve your experience, analyze website traffic, and support personalized advertising. You can accept or decline cookies through our cookie banner, and you can manage or delete cookies at any time in your browser settings.

sections.heading: 5. Third-Party Services
sections.body: We work with trusted third parties to run our store: Stripe and PayPal for payment processing, Clerk for authentication, and analytics providers to understand site usage. These parties process data only as needed to provide their services and under their own privacy policies.

sections.heading: 6. Information Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell your personal information. We share your information only with the service providers described above, when required by law, or with your consent.

sections.heading: 7. Data Security
sections.body: We use industry-standard measures to protect your personal information from loss, theft, misuse, and unauthorized access.

sections.heading: 8. Your Rights
sections.body: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information, and to object to certain processing. To exercise these rights, contact us at support@keyversely.com.

sections.heading: 9. Children's Privacy
sections.body: Our services are not directed to children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post any changes on this page with a revised date.

sections.heading: 11. Contact Us
sections.body: For any questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at support@keyversely.com or write to KeyVersely LLC, 63 N Burritt Ave Rm 100 Pmb 1180, Buffalo, Wyoming 82834 USA.

sections.heading: 1. Overview
sections.body: Because our products are digital and delivered instantly, all sales are final once the product has been delivered.

sections.heading: 2. Non-Refundable Digital Products
sections.body: Digital products, including software keys, game keys and subscriptions, are non-refundable and non-returnable once the product has been delivered to your email, because it can be used immediately.

sections.heading: 3. Exceptions
sections.body: We will consider a refund or replacement on a case-by-case basis if: the product key does not work, the product was not delivered due to a technical error on our side, or you received the wrong product.

sections.heading: 4. How to Request a Refund or Replacement
sections.body: Contact our support team at support@keyversely.com within 14 days of purchase with your order number and a description of the issue. We will investigate and respond within 24 hours.

sections.heading: 5. Unauthorized Transactions
sections.body: If you believe a charge was unauthorized, contact your payment provider and our support team immediately so we can investigate.

sections.heading: 6. Contact Information
sections.body: For any questions about this policy, contact KeyVersely LLC at support@keyversely.com or write to 63 N Burritt Ave Rm 100 Pmb 1180, Buffalo, Wyoming 82834 USA.

sections.heading: 1. Digital Delivery
sections.body: All products sold on Bigbl are digital. No physical items are shipped. After a successful payment, your product details, keys and download links are sent instantly.

sections.heading: 2. Delivery Time
sections.body: Digital products are usually delivered within minutes after payment is confirmed. In rare cases, delivery may take up to a few hours due to payment verification.

sections.heading: 3. What You Receive
sections.body: Your delivery email contains your keys or access details, download links, and instructions.

sections.heading: 4. Email Delivery
sections.body: Keys are sent to the email address you provided at checkout. Please make sure the address is correct. Check your spam or junk folder if you do not see the email.

sections.heading: 5. Missed Delivery
sections.body: If you have not received your email within a few hours, contact us at support@keyversely.com and we will resend it.

sections.heading: 6. No Physical Shipping
sections.body: Since all products are digital, there are no shipping fees, and delivery is worldwide with no customs or import charges.

sections.heading: 7. Contact Information
sections.body: For any questions, contact KeyVersely LLC at support@keyversely.com or write to 63 N Burritt Ave Rm 100 Pmb 1180, Buffalo, Wyoming 82834 USA.
